subject.title: fix(zai): add user-agent header to endpoint detection probe

question: Which Z.AI endpoint-detection User-Agent fix path should be canonical before merge: this one-line branch after proof/tests, or a better-tested sibling PR?
rationale: The patch shape is plausible, but proof remains mock-only and several open branches are competing for the same canonical issue.

options.title: Choose a tested canonical branch
options.body: Select one narrow PR with regression coverage and live proof or an explicit waiver, then close the duplicate candidates after it lands.

options.title: Continue this PR after proof
options.body: Ask this contributor to add focused header coverage and redacted after-fix Z.AI endpoint-detection evidence before treating this branch as the landing candidate.

options.title: Waive live proof for one branch
options.body: Maintainers may accept the canonical issue's live before-fix evidence plus source inspection, but should still land only one duplicate fix.

recommendation.title: Choose a tested canonical branch
recommendation.body: Select one narrow PR with regression coverage and live proof or an explicit waiver, then close the duplicate candidates after it lands.
